snippet.title: Battlefield 4 Naval Strike Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Battlefield 4™ Naval Strike expansion pack takes the all-out war to the sea with four new multiplayer maps. Available on March 25th for Battlefield 4 Premium members and April 15th for all. 

Own more, be more with Battlefield 4 Premium. Become a Battlefield 4 Premium member for early access to themed digital expansion packs, new weekly content and exclusive personalization options, all at a great value. Learn more at http://bit.ly/NuxrZ0
